primary_research_question: Why did Patient Decision Engine return -73.94% while Buy & Hold returned +90.48%?

gross_vs_net_breakdown.key_finding_1: The Patient Engine's raw directional timing was positive (+2,154.73 USDT gross, +21.55% gross return). However, executing 627 rapid round-trip transactions incurred 9,548.89 USDT in fees and slippage (95.49% of initial capital), completely destroying gross gains.

market_exposure_breakdown.key_finding_2: Sitting in cash for 93.36% of the 4.6-year period protected against drawdowns during bear regimes, but forfeited approximately 84.47 percentage points of BTC macro appreciation.

whipsaw_and_churn_breakdown.key_finding_3: A win rate of 24.40% across 627 short-duration trades indicates severe whipsaw vulnerability. The engine repeatedly entered on short-term momentum confirmation and exited on minor pullbacks.
